text:
Elaine Park: Heads up — we're formalizing the SI onramp lead flow today. Need quick alignment on: lead ownership windows, marketplace SKU mapping, and the minimum legal terms (MOU vs SOW) for early co-sell pilots.
Mike Chen: +1. can we keep ownership windows short (48h) for intake, then 7d claim for field?
Suresh Iyer: 48h for initial claim seems tight for large accounts. Recommend 72h intake -> 14d exclusive claim for deals >= $100k.
Tanya Lopez: Agree with tiered windows. small deals (<=25k) 48h, mid (25k-100k) 7d, large 14d. Keeps momentum while protecting field motion.
Alex G: For marketplace listings, we also need SKU mapping to Redwood product tiers (hosted, dedicated, private). Who owns the crosswalk?
Marc Rivers: Partnerships should own the mapping but need input from product for SKU-to-plan mapping and from sales for pricing tiers. I'll coordinate a short doc.
Elaine Park: Cool. OpsBot will post intake alerts to #partnerships-intake. @OpsBot can you include a CSV export with these fields: lead_id, account_name, ARR_est, region, SI_partner, marketplace_skus?
OpsBot: New integration: export CSV available. Usage: `/ops export intake --fields lead_id,account_name,ARR_est,region,si_partner,sku` — sample payload attached.
Mike Chen: Perfect. For rules of engagement (ROE), we need a simple rubric: 1) who is primary (SI vs Redwood rep) 2) outreach window 3) deal registration benefits (discounts / funding).
Suresh Iyer: + add IP/data ownership checklist for pilots. SI-run pilots must use customer-owned data or have explicit consent. No customer data cached on Redwood test instances without KBA.
Tanya Lopez: Also add a short clause on joint announcements: 2-week review window for both PR teams, no external naming of customers without written approval.
Marc Rivers: Drafting MOU template with those clauses. Question: do we require an MOU before co-selling outreach, or can handoffs occur under an enrollment form?
Elaine Park: Operationally, allow handoffs for discovery prior to MOU, but require MOU signed before joint sales incentives / MDF are paid.
Alex G: Noted. For hardware partners, procurement lead should be listed on the intake record and an estimated procurement lead time field added.
OpsBot: Field `procurement_eta_days` added to CSV schema.
Mike Chen: Escalation path: If ownership conflict after claim window, escalate to regional GTM lead. Add a 48h arbitration SLA.
Suresh Iyer: Add step: SI must provide customer intro email thread when claiming. That verifies authenticity.
Tanya Lopez: For reporting: weekly sweep of unclaimed leads >72h — partnerships ops to nudge. Can we schedule a Monday digest?
OpsBot: Weekly digest scheduled: Monday 09:30 PT to #partnerships. Includes unclaimed leads, claim expirations, and pending MOUs.
Marc Rivers: I'll produce the SKU crosswalk and MOU draft by EOD Thursday. Can someone from legal and product review? @Suresh @Alex?
Suresh Iyer: I can review legal clauses with our counsel — will do.
Alex G: Product will review SKU mapping and ensure pricing tiers are accurate.
Elaine Park: Great. Next steps: 1) Marc publishes draft 2) OpsBot verifies CSV schema 3) we test intake -> claim flow in sandbox next Tuesday. If anyone has objections to windows/tiers, speak now.
Mike Chen: No objections from sales.
Tanya Lopez: Fine from my side.
Elaine Park: Closing — thanks all. :thumbsup:
